newsitem.title: CANADA: Scott Paper unravels on low sale forecast.
newsitem.headline: Scott Paper unravels on low sale forecast.

text.p: Shares in Scott Paper Ltd slipped on comments by president David Erskine on Monday that the sale of the consumer products firm may not bring the C$26 a share price it reached last week.

"We feel we're near the end, and we're not necessarily going to get the 26 dollars which the stock traded at last week," Erskine told Reuters in a telephone interview. He declined to name the potential buyer.
Scott Paper has been seeking a merger since August.
Shares tumbled 2.85 to 23.15 on nearly a million shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange after hitting 26.00 on Friday.
